data.long_meaning: Thayvansh is a Hindu name that means 'Lord of Prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Thayv' which means 'Lord' and 'Ansh' which means 'Presence' or 'Manifestation'. This name is believed to bring abundance, wealth, and prosperity to the one who bears it. The name Thayvansh carries the meaning “Lord of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Thayvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Thayvansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Prosperity.”

The Thayvansh rulers continued the Chola tradition of patronage of art and architecture.
